prisoners.name: Rosemarie Dominguez
prisoners.description: Rosemarie Dominguez is a Little Village community activist and Chicago 10th District police council member. She told the Chicago Tribune that federal agents detained her on November 6, 2025 while she followed their vehicles and alerted community members to their presence. She reported approximately four hours in custody before release with a violation notice at the Broadview facility. She appeared in federal court on December 8 to contest the allegations.

cases.charges: Federal violation notice; specific statutory charge not established in reviewed sources
cases.sentence: Approximately four hours in custody, followed by release with a violation notice, according to her Tribune interview. No conviction or sentence established. The later citation outcome and exact release calendar date remain unset. Sources: https://www.pulitzer.org/winners/staff-chicago-tribune (December 30, 2025 Tribune reporting, Ticketed section); https://ccpsa.chicago.gov/district-council/10th-district-council/ (official council identity). Her account of agents firing pepper-spray projectiles at her vehicle and pushing her toward traffic is attributed testimony, not a separately adjudicated finding.
